thread:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: autoscaler error spike in eu-west-1. 503s observed on /v1/generate and increased queue latency. Pager -> @amber_oncall. Details: https://ops.redwood/example/1976543210

amber_oncall: saw the page, joining. pulling up metrics now.

amber_oncall: cloudwatch shows autoscaler failing to register new nodes, GPU pool #3 showing 'node join timeout' errors. CPU-backed fallbacks started for small requests but a lot of large requests still 503.

jake_sre: on it. i'm checking the node bootstrap logs. suspecting image pull throttling or kube-proxy flapping. can someone confirm if there was a recent infra deploy?

maria_runtime: no runtime deploys in the last 6h. we did push a quantized model variant earlier but that was in canary and shouldn't touch autoscaler.

rao_infra: i see a partial carryover from a maintenance window: some hosts in eu-west-1 had additional kernel updates queued, might've delayed kubelet restarts. i'm checking GCE instance states.

amber_oncall: ok, mitigation plan: 1) disable autoscaler for eu-west (prevent thrash) 2) scale up dedicated reserved pool manually by +4 nodes 3) route heavy traffic to eu-central fallback pool 4) post incident message to support. i'll start 1 & 2 now.

jake_sre: running command to disable autoscaler: ```sh
kubectl annotate deployment/autoscaler autoscale-disabled="true" -n redwood-system
```

jake_sre: applying manual scale to gpu-pool-eu-west: ```sh
kubectl scale --replicas=12 ds/gpu-pool-eu-west -n infra
```

amber_oncall: adding temporary routing override: setting smart-router policy for region fallback -> eu-central for requests with seq_len>1024. this should reduce pressure.

incident_bot: @channel: mitigation actions in progress. Current status: autoscaler paused, manual scale triggered, routing override applied. Customers possibly affected: several enterprise tenants in EU.

elaine_cs: i've pinged top 5 enterprise accounts (legal, finance customers) and escalated to priority support. waiting for CS notes, will post updates.

pm_tess: heads up to product — we should consider an opt-in degraded-mode notice in console if routing fallback engaged for >5m.

amber_oncall: initial impact estimate: ~6% of requests 503 over the last 12m, tail latency increased for long prompts. I'll capture exact numbers after we stabilize.

jake_sre: bootstrap logs show repeated gcr.io pull backoffs on 3 nodes due to regional registry rate limiting. re-pulling images to local cache on other hosts prevented further failures. raising GH issue for image caching.

rao_infra: confirm: registry throttling + simultaneous kubelet restarts due to queued kernel updates = node join timeouts. i've moved the pending kernel updates to maintenance window and forced restart of kubelet on the 3 stuck hosts. nodes are now Ready.

amber_oncall: traffic normalizing. 503s dropping to <0.5% for the last 4m. keeping autoscaler paused for now while we verify stability.

incident_bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigations reduced error rate; manual scale remains in effect. recommended next steps: schedule post-incident review, create remediation tasks, and inform customers.

maria_runtime: action item from runtime side: add a lighter-weight cold-start image (smaller tar) for node join path, and add local registry mirror for eu-west. owner: @maria_runtime. ETA: 2w.

jake_sre: action item: implement image pull backoff retry metrics and alert if >3 concurrent backoffs. owner: @jake_sre. ETA: 1w.

rao_infra: action item: ensure kernel updates are not auto-applied during critical rolling windows. update maintenance gating. owner: @rao_infra. ETA: 3d.

amber_oncall: CS action: send an incident summary to affected customers. owner: @elaine_cs. ETA: 2h.

pm_tess: product action: add routing-fallback visibility in Console. owner: @pm_tess / @maria_runtime. ETA: 3w.

amber_oncall: scheduling postmortem: propose 1976548000 (epoch) -> Tue 09:00 UTC. who can attend? want SRE, Infra, Runtime, Product, CS.

jake_sre: i'll be there.

maria_runtime: can do.

rao_infra: available.

elaine_cs: can attend.

pm_tess: on my calendar.

amber_oncall: i'll create a postmortem doc and link GH issues. Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (registry throttling + kernel restarts), mitigations applied, action items with owners and ETA, customer impact summary, follow-up verification plan.

jake_sre: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/3287 - "eu-west image pull resilience and local mirror". added initial notes.

amber_oncall: logging final mitigation state: autoscaler remains annotated disabled (manual revert required), manual scale to 12 replicas active, routing override still in place but monitoring for >10m before revert.

incident_bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): error rate back to baseline, monitoring continues. Please move to post-incident follow-up channel if needed.

amber_oncall: closing the live incident thread. action owners please update GH issues with progress. i'll post the postmortem doc in #incidents and link it here once ready. :white_check_mark:

elaine_cs: sending customer notes now. will post copy when done.

maria_runtime: starting on the smaller image + local mirror design doc and will link it to the GH issue.

jake_sre: will add alerting rules and dashboards for image pull backoffs.

rao_infra: i'll update maintenance gating and document the new kernel-update policy.

amber_oncall: thanks team. great work triaging quickly.
